purpose: Design proposals only, not production render assets

concepts.name: 기억의 저택
concepts.scene: Scene: an intimate modern memory-house with three connected open-front rooms around a broad oak atrium. Ivory plaster arches, curved staircase, teal built-in bookshelves, warm oak herringbone floors, an amber skylight. Exactly seven discrete oak workstations distributed 2 in the back-left room, 2 in the back-right room, 3 across the open front atrium. Each has a subtle floating translucent work screen and warm lamp; a few books, tea mugs and healthy plants. Quiet domestic intelligence, a welcoming manor where independent AI personalities share a home. Architecture feels imaginative but usable, not a literal film set. Morning sunlight, muted sage/cream/caramel and tiny amber technology accents.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-fidelity isometric environment artwork for a desktop session-management UI, NOT a rendered webpage.
Primary request: A beautifully crafted, cute yet sophisticated miniature office inside a fictional AI's shared mental world. AI sessions appear as distinct HUMAN-FORM digital colleagues, with gentle individual personalities, not animal mascots and not mechanical robots.
Visual standard: premium art-directed 3D miniature diorama; smooth anti-aliased geometry, intricate crafted furniture, soft global illumination, convincing wood grain, frosted glass and brushed metal, contact shadows and restrained cinematic volumetric light. Detailed enough for a large 1500px-wide UI stage. Absolutely no pixel art, voxel blocks, low-poly placeholders, flat diagram or blurred low-resolution look.
Cast: EXACTLY SEVEN small human-form AI colleagues, each at a clearly separate work station: a pearl-jacket short white-haired guide; a navy-jacket round-glasses engineer; a teal-coated short-haired analyst; a rust-knit dark-skinned maker; a plum-vest archivist; a silver-apron builder; a charcoal-cardigan observer. Charming sculpted 3D faces, varied adult genders and skin tones; each figure roughly 1/7 the height of the room walls, readable full-body or seated figure. Their garments have only a tiny luminous seam to imply synthetic identities. Original characters; no actor likenesses, no Marvel/film character costumes, symbols or copyrighted insignia.
Composition: consistent elevated 3/4 QUARTER-VIEW / isometric cutaway, all seven work stations visibly separated and reachable on sensible floors. The complete architecture floats as one well-framed miniature diorama. Wide landscape approximately 3:2. Scene occupies about 90% of image, comfortably within frame, full floor edges visible. Simple solid very dark charcoal background #191e25 matching the app. No room labels, no captions, no speech bubbles, no typography, no logos, no numbers, no UI chrome, no watermark. Do not use a flat overhead floorplan. Do not add extra people.

concepts.name: 생각의 아틀리에
concepts.scene: Scene: a spacious single-storey creative AI atelier, asymmetrical butterfly-shaped workshop, tall sawtooth glass skylights, brushed-aluminum beams, terracotta ceramic surfaces and honey-colored timber benches. Seven individual workstations in two staggered rows flanking a round low glass thought-table, each occupied by one AI colleague. A sculptural light mobile hangs over the common table; small organized pinboards, task lamps and instrument trays. Entire diorama visibly different from a mansion: airy creative industrial studio, warm off-white and burnt-orange accents, soft noon light and inviting handcrafted tools.

concepts.name: 밤의 기록관
concepts.scene: Scene: a two-tier miniature AI library-office arranged as a crescent cutaway, with dark walnut shelves, a small mezzanine reading gallery and clear brass-railed connecting staircase. Seven independent workstations: three on the upper gallery and four on the broad ground-floor arc, each with its own seated human-form AI. Deep midnight-blue structure, bottle-green velvet desk chairs, pools of golden desk-lamp light, scattered cream books and translucent blue work screens. The miniature structure is broad and spacious, no overlapping characters. Sophisticated cozy late-night library, fine joinery and tiny paper details, dark charcoal outer background. Not a wizard fantasy; original contemporary synthetic library.

concepts.name: 궤도형 관제실
concepts.scene: Scene: a circular two-level AI operations atelier under a cutaway transparent glass observatory canopy. Exactly seven individual curved consoles arranged like an open horseshoe around a small softly lit spherical core, with one distinct human-form AI colleague at each desk. Pearl ceramic, satin chrome and smoked glass, pale celadon accents and amber task lighting, small soft upholstered chairs and some understated greenery. Elegant retro-futurist interior with an open front entrance and gentle ramps, not a combat bridge, not a spaceship cockpit, no large glowing neon. Show a premium sculpted curved architecture silhouette, highly legible seven desk islands and relaxed personal objects. Dawn light, calm and human.

concepts.name: 마인드 가든
concepts.scene: Scene: seven separate small glass-and-oak office pavilions, one human-form AI colleague and one personal workstation in EACH pavilion, arranged on three terraced garden decks connected by slim pale-stone walking bridges. The center pavilion is slightly larger; the other six are grouped asymmetrically around it. A coherent cutaway indoor mind-garden, lush restrained miniature foliage, delicate frosted window arches, soft pink and amber study lamps, a shallow reflective water channel, readable paths. Premium handcrafted architectural model, warm ivory stone and sage glass, lots of airy negative space BETWEEN rooms but structure fills the frame. Golden-hour light. Distinctive serene original concept; not floating random office desks, not a whole city.
